name: SideSave
author: bytethecookie, forked from OpenSave by Siva Prakash
description: Peer-to-peer save sync for non-Steam Steam shortcuts. Syncs around gameplay, without leaving Game Mode.

publish.description: Keeps non-Steam shortcut saves in sync between your Steam Deck and your other devices, peer-to-peer. Syncs automatically before a game starts and after you quit, and can start the sync service without dropping to Desktop Mode.
